title: Add a connection: n8n / Webhook
urlHint: Paste the Production URL of the Webhook node in n8n, Make or Zapier.
secretIntro: NIVO signs every message so your receiver can tell it really came from NIVO. Keep this key private.
n8nStep1: Add a Webhook node: HTTP Method POST, Respond: Immediately. In Options, add Raw Body.
n8nStep2: Add a Code node right after it and paste the code below. Replace the key with the signing key above.
n8nStep3: Each message carries X-Nivo-Delivery. A retry has the same id, so you can use it to skip a message you already handled.
n8nNote: The Code node needs crypto allowed: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto on your n8n.
testIntro: Send one sample event to your address now. This only tests the connection.
testFailed: The test did not go through
testWarn: Real events will keep retrying until the receiver answers 2xx. You can continue and fix the address later.
doneIntro: Finish to start sending the events you picked.
